Package wellen

Class MidiClockOut

java.lang.Object
wellen.MidiClockOut
public class MidiClockOut extends Object
sends MIDI clock signals ( 24 pulses per quarter note ) to a MIDI output i.e makes wellen act as MIDI clock master for other applications or devices ( e.g a BeatMIDI in another sketch, a DAW or a drum machine ).

pulses are scheduled on absolute times on a dedicated thread, so the tempo does not drift. tempo changes take effect with the next pulse.

note that on macOS java's built-in MIDI implementation can not send MIDI clock messages to MIDI ports, see MidiOut.can_send_clock_and_sysex(). 

 
 MidiClockOut mClock = new MidiClockOut(new MidiOut("IAC Driver Bus 1"), 120);
 mClock.start();
